setup.effects: Build, apply additive local migrations, create the first real owner or preserve the existing owner, request ordinary outbox sign-in, then stop the temporary runtime. Refuse ambiguous legacy stores before changes.

verify.effects: Build and typecheck; run real Worker/D1 product/auth/restore tests, synthetic accessibility and real public-command/browser journeys at 1440 and 390. Includes native signed owner admission and responsive owner editor checks.

reset.effects: Require confirmation; refuse active state; remove only canonical local data, private settings and installer drafts. Preserve source, exports and deploy receipts.

deploy.effects: Dry-run builds and validates with zero provider calls; an explicit owner-authorized deployment uses the owner Cloudflare account and configured mail sender.

export.effects: Export all owned local D1 domain resources through Base portability, including private maps; exclude auth, grants, outbox and transient admission state.

import.effects: Require confirmation and an empty local destination; validate new and legacy archives, then atomically restore via Base portability. Does not recreate grants or owner.

preview.effects: Serve fixed production output, preserve local owner and durable state, stop after idle timeout or explicit stop.

artifact.effects: After build, emit an untrusted schema-2 managed delivery artifact and raw payloads. No deploy, provider call, tag, registration or public release.

health.meaning: D1 query and Worker availability; deployment identity when deploy-kit supplies it. Does not prove capture completeness or mail delivery.

authentication: Base operator-auth: active owner sessions rechecked for private APIs and documents; ordinary development outbox sign-in; project-scoped ingest and read grants unchanged. Optional signed first-owner claim shares native admission and permanently refuses a second owner; editor configuration rechecks owner sessions. Additional operator invitations remain disabled.
